name: learning-workflow
description: A 26-node agentic software engineering workflow packaged as portable agent skills: intake routing, evidence gathering, human authorization, braided parallel implementation, verification, CI gating, security audit, and closeout.
author: FY0627

skills.name: clarify-intent
skills.description: Turn a vague request into a bounded, structured intent before any planning happens.

skills.name: fix-issue
skills.description: Route a defect report into the evidence layer instead of patching it on sight.

skills.name: report-source
skills.description: Investigate existing source and produce evidence for downstream planning.

skills.name: feature-ready
skills.description: Accept work that already has a settled specification and route it straight to planning.

skills.name: requirements-spec
skills.description: Produce a requirements specification artifact as planning evidence.

skills.name: root-cause-analysis
skills.description: Produce a root cause analysis artifact as planning evidence.

skills.name: codebase-audit-summary
skills.description: Produce a structured audit of the existing codebase as planning evidence.

skills.name: implementation-plan
skills.description: Convert evidence artifacts into a reviewable implementation plan.

skills.name: human-approval
skills.description: Hard gate: the operator reviews the plan, accepts the risk, and authorizes implementation.

skills.name: implementation
skills.description: Execute the authorized plan and dispatch parallelizable work.

skills.name: subagents-overview
skills.description: Decompose work into independent subagent tasks with explicit interface contracts.

skills.name: sandbox-test
skills.description: Validate changes in a local sandbox before they reach shared branches.

skills.name: api-backend-agents
skills.description: Stabilize the shared API and backend surface that parallel tracks depend on.

skills.name: frontend-components
skills.description: Build view-layer components against the settled API surface and the project design tokens.

skills.name: code-consolidation
skills.description: Refactor and merge parallel output into one coherent implementation.

skills.name: visual-e2e-verify
skills.description: Visual acceptance: confirm the rendered result matches the intended design.

skills.name: e2e-verify
skills.description: End-to-end acceptance: confirm the behaviour works across the full path.

skills.name: github-actions-ci
skills.description: Run and interpret the repository CI gate: lint, types, tests, build.

skills.name: production-deployment-gate
skills.description: Release gate: decide whether verified changes may reach production.

skills.name: telemetry-global-memory
skills.description: Capture post-release telemetry and durable lessons for the next cycle.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Audit changes for security defects in parallel with the release gate.

skills.name: agents-md
skills.description: Update the project AGENTS.md conventions with what this cycle taught.

skills.name: organize-docs
skills.description: Organize and archive project documentation before closeout.

skills.name: project-closeout
skills.description: Close the loop: summarize outcomes and feed them back as the next cycle's input.

docs.description: The 26-node workflow graph and its design rationale.
Node-by-node provenance: what is replicated, inferred, or original.
The maturity tiers and the rules the validator enforces at each tier.
Cross-agent portability contract and degradation path.
How to write a description that triggers when it should and stays quiet otherwise.
Pre-release gates, mirroring the validator checks.
